meta.scaleNote: Every probability is an integer in ten-thousandths: divide by 10000. Rounding is bounded by half a ten-thousandth, which is finer than any figure shown and finer than the simulation's own standard error.
estimated: atLeastOneBeatsYou for 5 to 8 opponents; exact for 1 to 4, see atLeastOneIsExact
improvementNames: better category than the board makes
meta.notShipped: The all-in tables. Every entry is two lines of arithmetic over equityVsRanges and the stack depth, so the page computes them live from the formulas instead.
